incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - p99 latency SLO breach for /v1/generate - service: inference-api - triggered at 2026-03-14T02:10:56Z
pagerduty: Incident  PD-88421 created and notified on-call: Priya Patel
Priya Patel: Acked. Looking now. Observed p95 ~ 420ms, p99 spiking to 1.8s across regions.
Miguel Santos: Confirming from dashboards — EU region p99 ~2.1s, US-west ~1.6s. Request rate steady, CPU/GPU not saturated.
Riley Chen: Can we see queue sizes / backlog on the serving runtime?
Priya Patel: Pulling serving metrics... kv-cache hit rate dropped from 87% -> 22% in last 8m.
Samir Kapoor: That's odd. Any recent rollout?
Ava Lopez: Yes, we pushed a caching config tweak 00:55 UTC to change prefix keying for safety. Might be related.
Priya Patel: Reverting cache change on a canary now. Command: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/cache-service --to-revision=2`
Riley Chen: Noted. Also enabling route fallback to smaller model variant for tail requests. Command: `redwood route update --name gen --fallback model:llama-7b-quant`
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Priya Patel acknowledged the incident.
Miguel Santos: Running quick health check: `curl -sS https://metrics.internal/api/serving/queues | jq '.queues | map(select(.len>0))'` -> seeing 6 queues >1000 items, high latencies correlated.
Priya Patel: Cache rollback started. Watching kv-cache hit rate...
Ava Lopez: Adding a temporary autoscale bump for serving pool: `kubectl scale --replicas=12 deploy/serve-gpu` (from 8)
Samir Kapoor: Suggest lowering batch windows to reduce tail latency. Changing batch.max_wait from 40ms -> 10ms for hot routes.
Riley Chen: Applying batch change now. `edits applied to config/batcher.yaml`
Priya Patel: Cache rollback completed on canary; hit rate recovering on that pod.
Miguel Santos: p99 in canary region dropped to 420ms. Global p99 still ~1.2s.
Ava Lopez: Autoscale taking effect — new replicas coming up (3/12 ready so far).
Priya Patel: Good. Noting customer impact: interactive chat sessions may see delayed assistant replies; estimated affected percent ~8% of requests (tail-heavy).
Samir Kapoor: Opening a customer advisory draft for SRE review. Low severity? It's SLO breach but partial impact.
Riley Chen: FYI, rollout that changed prefixing was intended to fix a rare cache key collision but regressed cache hits. We'll add unit test.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation to Miguel Santos at +5m due to ongoing p99 breach.
Miguel Santos: Taking over lead for mitigation. Priya can start the post-incident checklist.
Priya Patel: On it. Capturing timeline and actions. Will start postmortem doc.
Ava Lopez: p99 now 680ms and trending down as more replicas ready and batch window lowered.
Samir Kapoor: Recommend keeping fallback routing enabled for 30m and monitor error rates — no increase in 5xx so far.
Riley Chen: Agreed. Keeping batch changes in prod until end of incident.
Priya Patel: Handoff note: I'll hand to Miguel in 20 minutes for monitoring and closure. Next on-call (Riley) at 03:00 UTC — Miguel please confirm you will run final checks before handoff.
Miguel Santos: Confirmed. I'll run final verification and close PD when metrics are stable for 15m.
Priya Patel: Created PD incident notes and annotated SLO dashboard. ETA to normal: 25 minutes if trends hold.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-88421 updated (status: investigating)
Ava Lopez: Quick follow-up: will open a rollback protection PR to prevent untested cache key changes from hitting prod without simulation.
Priya Patel: Thanks. Logging customer impact for postmortem: p99 SLO breached 02:10:56 -> 02:42:00 UTC, peak affected requests ~8%.
Miguel Santos: Final check at 02:47 UTC — p99 stable ~210ms, p95 ~120ms. Closing actions: revert commit to be marked as root cause, add integration test, make cache config change gated behind feature flag.
Priya Patel: PD-88421 resolving in 10m after stability window. Good job team. :thumbsup:
pagerduty: Incident PD-88421 resolved by Miguel Santos at 2026-03-14T02:47:00Z
Priya Patel: Postmortem stub created: docs/incidents/PD-88421-cache-keying-latency-burn.md — will flesh out in morning.
